notice: Upstream chart mirrored for research and country-package authoring. Not accountant reviewed, not a PHP Ledger release, not installable into a real company, and not a statement that any account number is legally mandated. Root types, normal balances and role hints were derived mechanically from the upstream account_type vocabulary and must be reviewed before reuse.
